evidence.fact: A descriptor carries required media type, digest, and raw-byte size; content with the wrong length should not be trusted.
The digest is the content identifier; consumers independently hash retrieved bytes and compare the result to the descriptor before consumption.
Implementations must support SHA-256 verification and its encoded portion is exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
